text: あせ　かいて　すこし　やせた　きが　するぜえ

structure.en: I worked up a sweat, and

patterns.name: 〜気がする
patterns.span: やせた　きが　するぜえ
patterns.explanation: きがする after a statement says that is how it feels to you, without being sure. やせた きが する = 'I feel like I lost weight'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て ending joins this action to what comes next, like 'and', here also hinting at the reason. あせ かいて = 'I worked up a sweat, and'.

patterns.name: 〜ぜ
patterns.explanation: ぜ at the end is rough, manly talk that pushes your point; here it is drawn out to ぜえ. きが するぜえ = 'I feel like it, man!'.
